visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female host wearing a striped black and white shirt, blue leggings, and a beige cap stands beside a white Yamaha scooter at an outdoor racing track. She gestures excitedly toward the vehicle. (2) Detailed close-up shots of the scooter's bodywork are shown, including the front fairing, intake vents, LED headlights, and the blue side panels with 'Cygnus X' branding. (3) A rider in full professional racing gear (black, pink, and blue suit with a colorful helmet) is shown leaning into corners on the track while riding the scooter. (4) Close-ups of technical components such as the engine block, rear suspension springs, and tires are displayed in a studio setting with bright lighting. (5) The host demonstrates the storage capacity by opening the seat and placing a full-face helmet inside. (6) The host returns to the trackside setting, counting points on her fingers as she discusses the vehicle's features, ending with a call to action toward the camera.

Secondary backgrounds include a brightly lit studio space with white pedestals for displaying mechanical parts and a text-branded wall with 'CYGNUS X' logos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, fast-tempo electronic BGM featuring a driving four-on-the-floor kick drum. A female voice speaks with high enthusiasm and rapid speech rate, greeting the audience. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual cut, followed by the audible roar of a scooter engine idling. The BGM remains dominant in the background. (3) As technical details are listed, 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects punctuate the host's points. The host's voice remains clear and professional with a bright spectral profile. (4) During the riding sequence, the sound of wind rushing and high-pitched engine acceleration is mixed over the BGM, creating a sense of speed. (5) The audio transitions back to a purely narrative focus with the music's volume slightly ducked to emphasize the host's review of pros and cons. The phase ends with an upbeat final phrase and a fading musical tail.
